name: Sunset Smile
description:
Penthouse duplex with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a large rooftop terrace offering 360-degree panoramic views of the sea, mountains and surrounding landscape. Located within a Mediterranean-style residential complex in the heart of the New Golden Mile, the property is conveniently situated close to supermarkets, beaches, beach clubs, restaurants, golf courses, and the towns of Estepona and Marbella.

The spacious terrace provides an ideal setting for enjoying the Costa del Sol throughout the day, with sun loungers for relaxing, outdoor dining areas, comfortable seating and a barbecue area, all surrounded by impressive panoramic views.

The space

The apartment is within walking distance of a modern club offering facilities such as padel courts, fitness facilities, a children's club and a restaurant.

The property has been recently decorated throughout in a fresh and contemporary style.

Kitchen

The kitchen is fully equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay, including a fridge-freezer, oven, microwave, hob, mixer, Nespresso coffee machine, kettle and washing machine.

Dining area

The dining area features a dining table with seating for up to 6 people.

Living room

The comfortable living room features a Smart TV with access to streaming services such as Netflix and Disney+. Large sliding doors provide direct access to the terrace and allow plenty of natural light into the space, with views towards the sea and mountains.

Bedroom 1

The main bedroom features a double bed (180 × 200 cm), large fitted wardrobes and an en-suite bathroom equipped with a bathtub, shower, sink and toilet.

The bedroom also enjoys views of the sea and mountains.

Bedroom 2

The second bedroom features 2 single beds (90 × 200 cm), large fitted wardrobes for clothes and personal belongings, and views towards the sea and mountains.

Bathroom 2

The second bathroom is equipped with a shower, sink and toilet.

Rooftop terrace

Stairs lead to the spacious rooftop terrace, which extends across the property and offers impressive 360-degree panoramic views of the sea, mountains and valley.

The terrace features a covered outdoor dining area with a table for 6 people, a barbecue corner equipped with a Weber gas barbecue, and several areas for relaxing in the sun.

At the front of the terrace, guests will find 2 additional sun loungers and a spacious corner seating area overlooking the sea, mountains and communal swimming pool.

Other facilities

* High-speed WiFi (600 Mb)

* Central air conditioning and heating throughout the property

* High chair and cot available upon request

* Blinds on all windows

* 2 free parking spaces

* Lift

* Large shared swimming pool

* Gated residential community with security cameras

Services and common areas

Guests have access to:

* The entire apartment

* Shared seasonal swimming pool

* Communal garden areas

Swimming pool information

The swimming pool is part of the shared facilities of the residential complex and is managed by the community.

Please note that we have no control over the swimming pool's opening hours, availability, maintenance, or any decisions made by the residential community regarding its operation.

Current swimming pool opening hours:

* Easter Week: 12:30–18:30

* May: 12:30–18:30

* June: 11:30–19:30

* July: 10:30–20:30

* August: 10:30–20:30

* September: 11:30–19:30

* 1–15 October: 12:30–18:30

Please keep in mind that opening dates and hours are determined by the residential community and may be subject to change.

Government measures, including drought or water restrictions in Spain, may result in temporary pool closures.

In exceptional circumstances, such as maintenance, repairs or water quality inspections, the swimming pool may also be temporarily unavailable without prior notice.

We always do our best to provide the most accurate and up-to-date information; however, we cannot guarantee the availability of the swimming pool during your stay. Refunds or compensation cannot be provided due to changes in opening hours or temporary pool closures.

Other things to note

Security deposit

A refundable security deposit of €300 is required before arrival. The amount must be pre-authorised using a valid credit card through the secure payment link provided before check-in.

Please note that debit cards and other payment methods cannot be used for this pre-authorisation. Completion of the security deposit pre-authorisation is mandatory before arrival.

Location and distances

Renting a car is highly recommended for exploring the surrounding area.

Puerto Banús: 16 km – approximately 15 minutes

Estepona: 12 km – approximately 13 minutes

Benahavís: 14 km – approximately 20 minutes

Beach / Sonora Beach Club: 3 km – approximately 5 minutes

Selwo Aventura: 3 km – approximately 9 minutes

Málaga Airport: 57 km – approximately 50 minutes

Hospiten Estepona: 2 km – approximately 5 minutes

Lidl Supermarket: 4 km – approximately 9 minutes

Mercadona Supermarket: 4 km – approximately 9 minutes

Elements Gym Marbella: 15 km – approximately 17 minutes

M13 Gymnasium: 16 km – approximately 18 minutes

Real Padel Club Marbella: 15 km – approximately 17 minutes

Golf enthusiasts will find approximately 60 golf courses within a 50 km radius.

Important booking information

Please note that we welcome families and couples only. Groups where all guests are under 30 years old are not accepted, and stag or hen parties are strictly prohibited.

If your group does not fall within these categories but you would still like to book, please send us a detailed enquiry with some information about yourself and the people you will be travelling with. We will be happy to review the request on your behalf.

We look forward to welcoming you!
